surfaces.label: Authentication (API key + JWT)
surfaces.notes: HMAC timing-safe compare; HS256 header/claims validation; jti revocation; production secret guard

surfaces.label: Authorization — role/user grant boundary
surfaces.notes: authz-role-assignment: grantor authority never checked on role/user mutations

surfaces.label: SQL/DDL injection
surfaces.notes: Prepared statements everywhere; identifiers allow-listed; static migrations

surfaces.label: Command/code execution
surfaces.notes: No exec/eval/child_process sinks in runtime or scripts

surfaces.label: SSRF/outbound network
surfaces.notes: No outbound HTTP client in runtime code

surfaces.label: Path traversal/file I/O
surfaces.notes: No HTTP-controlled paths reach fs; fixed filenames under operator env dirs

surfaces.label: XSS/template injection
surfaces.notes: Server/client escaping covers HTML text+attr; CSP present (unsafe-inline noted)

surfaces.label: Audit integrity
surfaces.notes: Hash chain + verify() cross-checks JSON and indexed columns; actor from authenticated subject

surfaces.label: Rate limiting/DoS
surfaces.notes: Sliding window per socket IP, 10k bucket cap, 1MiB body cap

surfaces.label: Secrets/config
surfaces.notes: No hardcoded secrets; TTY guard; prod fail-fast; hashed API keys

surfaces.label: CORS/CSRF/headers
surfaces.notes: CORS opt-in; no cookie sessions; security headers + HSTS on SSR

surfaces.label: Supply chain/CI
surfaces.notes: Frozen lockfile, zero runtime deps, pnpm audit gate, non-root container user

surfaces.label: Legacy reference tree
surfaces.notes: Excluded: not imported/deployed; sibling agent covers gap analysis
